pr.body:
## Summary
- add offline canonical datastore schema and safe pack importer
- add deterministic active-source resolver and coldstart reports
- produce full dry-run reconciliation artifacts for the June 22 pack

## Validation
- python -m tools.task_orchestrator_reconcile.import_pack --input /tmp/to-all-dbs-20260622T192814Z --output /tmp/to-canonical-full-dryrun.sqlite --archive /private/tmp/to-all-dbs-20260622T192814Z.tar.gz --redacted-only --resolve-current --emit-report audit_inputs/task-orchestrator-canon/to-all-dbs-20260622T192814Z/IMPORT_REPORT.json --emit-coldstart audit_inputs/task-orchestrator-canon/to-all-dbs-20260622T192814Z/COLDSTART_RECONCILIATION.json --emit-conflicts audit_inputs/task-orchestrator-canon/to-all-dbs-20260622T192814Z/CONFLICTS.json
- sqlite3 /tmp/to-canonical-full-dryrun.sqlite 'PRAGMA integrity_check;'
- python -m json.tool audit_inputs/task-orchestrator-canon/to-all-dbs-20260622T192814Z/IMPORT_REPORT.json
- python -m json.tool audit_inputs/task-orchestrator-canon/to-all-dbs-20260622T192814Z/COLDSTART_RECONCILIATION.json
- python -m json.tool audit_inputs/task-orchestrator-canon/to-all-dbs-20260622T192814Z/CONFLICTS.json
- git diff --check
